commitResults.messageTitle: Organize classes into jamal and jamal.task packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Move the six classes out of the default package so the project has a
proper package structure, as required by the A-Packages increment.
src/main/java remains the source root.

The task data model (Task, Todo, Deadline, Event) goes into jamal.task
because those four are the part of the program that would survive a
rewrite of the chatbot around them. The entry point (JamaL) and the
user-facing exception (JamaLException) stay in jamal as app-level code.

JamaL.java imports the four task classes explicitly rather than with a
wildcard, so what crosses the package boundary is visible at a glance.
No class bodies changed: Task was already public with public accessors,
so the split needed no visibility edits.

Note: the IntelliJ run configuration main class must be updated from
JamaL to jamal.JamaL.
